purpose: Describe continuity and fragmentation within one vehicle's capped returned drive-history window, not lifetime history or trip intent.
primaryGoal: Adjust the maximum parking gap and inspect observed chains, stopovers, structural and energy indicators, calendar profiles, ranked chains and evidence limitations.

dataSources.behavior: Enabled only with a vehicle; isolated drivingKeys.history key; bounded limit; MODERATE staleTime; safeArray selection; request receives cancellation signal. Listing validates vehicle_id and delegates pagination/date bounds to repository. No date bounds or pagination beyond this single request are supplied by this page.
dataSources.unknowns: Repository ordering, live server response, pagination cap implementation, complete history coverage and runtime API compatibility were not exercised.

dataSources.sourceOwner: Existing workspace selection/timezone hooks; implementations not inspected.
dataSources.behavior: Workspace selected vehicle supplies history identity; vehicle timezone supplies calendar grouping. No competing local vehicle selector. /journey-fragmentation is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS (web\src\lib\workspaceScope.ts:23-77); this is explicitly a capped-history report, not an existing selected-date report. Do not silently replace its history with a date subset.

Memoized derived model, frozen analysis clock, stable segmented time sorting, mutually exclusive row/pair accounting, address/GPS continuity, threshold sensitivity, SI distance/energy/duration operands and local-calendar profiles. Missing energy remains null; complete-energy distance weights intensity. UI minutes are analysis thresholds, not changed wire units.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing ChartContainer and category chart primitives; consider a local typed count-distribution renderer only after preserving unique summaries, labels, empty messages and export behavior. Do not create a new global chart engine.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use the current metric/layout owner or one feature-local accounting list, retaining all six categories in each group and totals.

responsive.strategy: Page grids stack until lg; directory cards use md two-column layout; accounting groups split at lg, with two small tiles per group throughout; toolbar wraps. Grid supports minItemWidth but this page uses viewport columns.

issues.detail: Directory switches to two inner columns at md even when its parent becomes half-width at lg; long source addresses at lines 37-41 lack explicit anywhere wrapping. Narrow allocated cards and overflow are risks, not observed failures.
issues.fix: Use existing container-aware Grid/minItemWidth or reviewed CardGrid behavior and source-address wrapping; verify all addresses and ranks remain reachable at ten widths, sidebar states and 200% text.

issues.detail: Seven full localized weekday labels share an X axis; twelve local-time buckets and potentially many month labels also use default axis tick behavior. Label clipping/omission is unverified.
issues.fix: Exercise long-label locales and allocated container widths using existing chart sizing/tick policies; retain full data table and all underlying counts rather than dropping categories.

accessibility.status: keyboard, screen reader, effective contrast, forced colors and target spacing unverified
accessibility.strengths: Select has a localized accessible name; shared focus styling; panels use h2 typography; domain decorative icons generally aria-hidden; all six charts have ariaLabel and data/dataColumns; sensitivity has ariaDescription; shared FadeIn honors reduced-motion preference in source; shared OperationalBrief names its section.

issues.detail: Threshold Select uses size=sm, mapped to min-h-9 (36px) in Select.tsx:33, below the contract's default 44px mobile target. Actual target spacing/WCAG exception has not been measured.
issues.fix: Apply existing larger/density-aware sizing or page-level minimum target class on touch layouts; keep native selection semantics and accessible label.

states.initialLoading: Six ChartContainers receive loading; summary receives loading and suppresses raw values. Other panels inspect empty derived result first, showing empty messages rather than initial skeletons.
states.empty: All fourteen section shells remain mounted; domain/chart bodies use empty states. Methodology always remains readable. Report context describes returnedRows=0.
states.noVehicle: History query disabled; summary instructs selection using shared workspace owner; analytical result derives from [] and empty shells stay visible.
states.fatalError: JourneyEvidenceBrief receives drivesState.fatalError and retry; PageLayout receives only freshness query, not a replacement error prop, so neighboring section shells survive.
states.staleOffline: StaleRefreshWarning preserves retained data and offers retry; summary receives retained. Nested metric summaries currently do not receive retained/unavailable flags.
states.success: All sections derive from the same result and selected continuity threshold.
states.partial: Incomplete records, excluded rows, unusable boundaries and complete-energy support explicitly represented; not evidence of independent backend sources.

issues.detail: Initial request uses result=[]; elapsed component selects EmptyState before its loading-aware brief. StructureIndicators, EnergyIntensityPanel, JourneyDirectory, AccountingPanel and footer similarly communicate empty/no rows before a response. Several accept loading through the common interface but never consume it.
issues.fix: Propagate a typed source-state/loading contract to each panel body; show loading/unavailable versus verified empty distinctly while keeping all shells, methodology and retained payload visible.

issues.detail: Nested summaries for structure, elapsed and energy are not passed retained/unavailable state, despite NestedDrivingBrief supporting both (lines 20-21,60-66). During failed/offline refresh the page warning says retained while nested badges default to Returned evidence.
issues.fix: Thread existing DataState meaning to nested briefs, using existing retained/unavailable props; retain values and independent retry at source level without labeling cached data fresh.

visualIssues.detail: Directory cards use fixed-white translucent border/background; accounting tiles use bg-white/[0.03] at lines 58,62. These bypass semantic surface/border tokens across light/custom themes.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface/border variables or current shared Card/LayoutCard variants, retaining ranks, addresses, distance, durations and gap counts.

visualIssues.detail: The same journeys count receives different CHART_COLORS indices across chain/hour/weekday/month sections (0,3,4,5), while gap count uses 1 and sensitivity uses 0/2. Source suggests decorative multihue emphasis rather than a consistent measure mapping; actual saturation is unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Adopt existing restrained palette/series policy for repeated count measures and semantic comparison roles. Preserve saved explicit chart preferences, every series and sensitivity legend key.

visualIssues.detail: Three sections put a surface-owning OperationalBrief inside GlassPanel, repeat section/brief titles and descriptions, and each adds its details affordance. This produces nested panel chrome in elapsed, structure and energy rather than one clear section hierarchy.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse the accepted layout/composite composition contract; coordinate an embedded presentation variant only if existing owners cannot preserve summary scope/provenance/details inside one surface. Do not remove explanations or drawers to reduce noise.

architectureIssues.detail: User-visible returned/included dates use fixed en-US Intl formatting, although vehicle timezone is preserved. _types.ts:8-10 formats percentages with Math.round/string interpolation, and sensitivity threshold labels use a hardcoded 'min' suffix at line 10.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing locale/date and number formatting owners at the display boundary; localize duration/band labels and energy supportBand values while preserving calculation keys and timezone.

architectureIssues.detail: distanceM maps absent/nonfinite/nonpositive distance to 0. Directory and included-distance totals can therefore display measured zero for source distance that is unknown. Energy correctly excludes incomplete distance/energy, but no distance-coverage field distinguishes missing operands.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration/domain owner should assess a nullable or coverage-aware derived display contract without changing the wire/cache or silently redefining existing aggregates. Until reviewed, preserve model behavior and disclose unavailable distance rather than claiming observed zero.

architectureIssues.detail: Active evidence brief derives props through ComponentProps<typeof EvidenceBand>, coupling its presentation contract to an unmounted alternate metric-card renderer that remains barrel-exported.
architectureIssues.fix: Use one explicit shared feature evidence-props contract; confirm references before retiring or adapting alternate implementation. Do not restore old colored MetricCard composition.

priority.first: Distinguish initial/unavailable/retained states in all panels; review missing-distance semantics.
priority.next: Neutralize fixed-white tiles, resolve nested summary surfaces, locale formatting and touch/container behavior without changing analysis scope.

preservation.hashAlgorithm: SHA-256 of current raw page bytes
preservation.lineCountScope: Page plus twelve mounted journey-fragmentation TSX sections; excludes unmounted EvidenceBand and operational brief adapters, so 739 is not a full feature total.
preservation.sectionEvidence: Page:79-88,90-94,97-104,106-120. Six ChartContainer sites, six GlassPanel sites in twelve mounted domain sections, one summary composite and one LayoutCard footer.
sectionDetails: Summary: five raw metrics; journey/included count, linked/adjacent count, multi-drive share/count, short fragment count/denominator, active days/weeks; evidence band and 1000-row cap.
Chain distribution: fragments versus journey count, median and p90.
Gap distribution: linked minute bands/count, median/p90 and supporting gap count.
Sensitivity: thresholds 30/60/120/240; journeys and linked pairs, two legend series with persisted visibility.
Elapsed: driving seconds, observed linked parking seconds and linked stopovers.
Structure: short fragments/denominator, short-fragment distance/share, compact chains, included distance and display-unit boundary explanation.

Energy: single/multi-drive intensities, complete/total group journey counts, distance coverage and complete-energy distance; observed difference, support band/minimum; missing-energy and noncausality caveat.
Profiles: two-hour local starts, seven local weekdays, sparse local calendar months.
Directory: top eight by fragments then distance; rank, leading trophy, included-drive count, distance, start/end address with unknown fallbacks, elapsed duration and linked-gap count.
Accounting: returned rows and all six row category entries; adjacent pairs and six pair categories; returned/included spans, days since latest included drive and active local days/weeks.
Methodology: six explanations for segmented ordering, continuity (GPS tolerance/gap), journey-count invariant, complete-energy intensity, frozen clock/timezone, capped scope/noncausality.
Report context: empty versus populated explanatory text; additional empty-state message when no returned rows.

dataBehavior: History is a single capped observed window, never guaranteed lifetime data; no workspace date control is currently consumed.
Analysis clock is fixed once on page mount; refresh/threshold/timezone changes do not advance it.
Source array is not mutated; segmented stable sort, unusable boundaries, excluded categories and adjacent-pair categories are preserved.
Each included drive belongs to exactly one journey; included drives minus linked pairs equals journey count.
Continuity requires included adjacent records, nonnegative gap within threshold, normalized-address match or valid GPS within 250m.
Short stopover 30min, short fragment 5000m, compact chain 50000m; energy recommended support three complete journeys per group.
Complete-energy journeys only, distance-weighted Wh/m, absent energy is null, descriptive difference is not causality.
Raw SI remains in wire/cache/domain; useUnits conversion only in presentation, with existing specialist energy formatter retained.
All section shells and explanations survive no vehicle, empty and fatal outcomes; retained data survives background refresh failure.
